packs.name: Bug investigation team
packs.baseline: From starter/: python3 -m unittest -v. The supplied quantity test intentionally fails before the fix; the other two pass.

packs.name: Website launch team
packs.baseline: From starter/: python3 -m http.server 4311 --bind 127.0.0.1, then open http://127.0.0.1:4311. Stop with Ctrl-C. This manual preview is not an automated UI test.

packs.name: Codebase onboarding team
packs.baseline: From starter/: python3 -m unittest -v. For a disposable example: python3 app.py --file demo-notes.json add "Read the guide" then python3 app.py --file demo-notes.json list. Delete only your practice file when finished.

packs.name: Python automation team
packs.baseline: From starter/: python3 -m unittest -v. Some tests intentionally fail until summarize is implemented. After implementation: python3 summarize.py fixtures/expenses.csv. Use --output result.json only to create a new file.

packs.name: Game prototype team
packs.baseline: From starter/: node --test. To play: python3 -m http.server 4312 --bind 127.0.0.1 and open http://127.0.0.1:4312. Stop the server with Ctrl-C. Baseline tests cover movement only; collection is your task.

packs.name: Story and worldbuilding team
packs.baseline: No program needs to run. Import the template, inspect the shared sample sources and give the team the kickoff objective. A file tool is optional if you want deliverables written to disk.
